messages:
anya: quick share — ran Llama3-medium int8 onboarding across us-east / us-west / eu-west on H100 + A100. seeing odd p95 skew in eu-west, posting quick summary and logs below.

sam: nice, did you run with the same kernel stacks?

anya: yes same binary, but kernel selection differs. H100 bound to triton-kernel-v2, A100 fell back to cudnn-path for some ops. warmup config: --warmup=4 requests.

michael: can you paste the p50/p95 numbers?

anya: sure — quick paste from rbench:
```
model, gpu, region, p50_ms, p95_ms, qps
llama3-med-int8, h100, us-east, 48, 112, 160
llama3-med-int8, h100, us-west, 52, 118, 150
llama3-med-int8, h100, eu-west, 55, 170, 140
llama3-med-int8, a100, us-east, 60, 140, 130
llama3-med-int8, a100, eu-west, 63, 195, 120
```

anya: note the eu-west p95 is ~40% higher vs us-east on both GPUs. p50s are similar.

judy: that screams extra network hop or proxy queue. any routing differences?

anya: yes — found a routing rule mismatch: a subset of EU requests were being proxied via an edge egress in us-west due to an older geo-prefer tag on that route. caused extra hop + 18-30ms and occasionally bumped latency when proxy egress qlen spiked.

ops: paste from proxy logs for the window:
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:13Z] proxy-eu-west -> edge-us-west hop=1 queue_ms=22 req_id=ab12
[2026-03-19T14:02:13Z] proxy-eu-west -> edge-us-west hop=1 queue_ms=45 req_id=ab13
[2026-03-19T14:02:14Z] proxy-local hit kernel-triton warmup miss kvcache
```

sam: are kernel fallbacks contributing? if A100 uses cudnn slow path maybe p95 multiplies.

anya: partially. profiling shows token step time on A100 cudnn path ~8% higher per-token; but the big jump is routing+queue. when we force local regional routing (bypass the bad proxy) eu-west p95 drops from 170->125 on H100.

michael: any difference with larger warmup (e.g., --warmup=8)?

anya: yes — increasing warmup to 8 reduces cold-tail spikes for long sequences; p95 improves ~7-10ms across all regions, but doesn't eliminate the proxy-induced tail.

judy: what's the recommendation for GA?

anya: short term: 1) fix routing tag so EU stays local (rolling rule deploy done) 2) pin kernel policy: prefer triton-kernel-v2 on H100, fallback policy stricter on A100 until we add optimized kernels 3) add per-route p95 in Console (dashboard PR ready) 4) canary: route 10% eu traffic to us-east fallback to compare quality & cost.

infra-bot: deploybot: routing-rule update succeeded (canary 5% -> 10%) :rocket:

ops: monitoring note — watch proxy-egress qlen and route p95 for next 24h. I'll add alert if delta > 25ms for 5m window.

anya: thanks all. next step I'll attach full perf histograms and kernel flame traces in the doc and open a follow-up for quant regression tests (quality vs int8). :memo:
